items.detail: BLOCKED on capability, not on a check: there is no way to assemble an Exp 4 network from pool line ids and score it. routepool.py exposes only generate_pool/PoolAudit, and score_state takes GeometryEdits over the LEGACY network. See EXPERIMENT4_BLOCKERS.md

items.title: Outer network search recovers an exhaustively known optimum
items.detail: BLOCKED on capability: there is no outer network search to test, and no assembly layer to build the enumerated envelope from. Gate 4-14 also rules out substituting the 2B benchmark. See EXPERIMENT4_BLOCKERS.md

items.title: Committed gate on common-lines exposure
items.detail: ACCEPTANCE.md Gate 4-10 -- every promoted network reruns the diagnostic; if exposure balloons the result is classified model-dependent

items.title: Committed transfer-depth, path-cap and OD-cap adequacy gates
items.detail: ACCEPTANCE.md Gate 4-9 covers all three: deeper max_rounds on promoted networks, the 4->6 paths-per-OD sensitivity redone, and certification on a materially wider OD set than the top 20,000

items.title: Demand-robustness claims written before the winner is known
items.detail: Gate 4-12 is COMMITTED in ACCEPTANCE.md, but the CLAIMS themselves are not written. They must exist before any Exp 4 winner is known, so this is cheap now and impossible later

items.title: Structural-distance measurement exists
items.detail: contract.py computes network_edit_distance_pct with a committed cap; ACCEPTANCE Gate 4-13 requires geometry-based identity because Exp 4 route ids are synthetic

items.title: Every ACCEPTANCE.md rejection condition in place before scoring
items.detail: 15 of 15 gates written; scripts/exp4_gates.py now executes them: 9 MET, 4 ARMED (they fire on a promoted network and cannot be satisfied before the search), 2 OPEN. Remains MANUAL because 'armed' is a judgement that the right machinery exists, not a proof
